findings.excerpt: `version` in pyproject.toml must already be the new number
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:13 `dynamic = ["version"]`（无 project.version 键）；pyproject.toml:43-44 `[tool.hatch.version] path = "src/docproof/__init__.py"`；src/docproof/__init__.py:3 `__version__ = "0.2.4"`；.github/workflows/release.yml:56-76 的发布门禁按 hatch 路径读取 __version__，而非 project.version
findings.replacement: # `__version__` in src/docproof/__init__.py must already be the new number, and the commit must be on main

findings.evidence: 同 4.1：版本号实际来自 src/docproof/__init__.py，pyproject.toml 只通过 [tool.hatch.version] 声明路径；release.yml:61-72 先用 tomllib 读该路径，再读 __version__ 行
findings.replacement: | tag vs `src/docproof/__init__.py`（版本文件路径由 pyproject.toml 的 `[tool.hatch.version]` 指定） |

findings.excerpt: The workflow checks the tag against `pyproject.toml`
findings.evidence: release.yml:61-63 读取 pyproject 的 `tool.hatch.version.path`，再在 :70-76 从该文件读取 __version__ 与 tag 比较；直接说“against pyproject.toml”会误导读者以为版本号写在 pyproject
findings.replacement: The workflow reads the version-source path from `pyproject.toml` and checks the tag against the `__version__` line it contains

findings.excerpt: docproof actually going up on PyPI on 24 August 2026
findings.evidence: PyPI JSON：0.2.1 upload_time=2026-08-21T18:48Z（+08 为 8 月 22 日）、0.2.3=2026-08-24T15:53Z、0.2.4=2026-08-31T08:19Z；git d3c10bc（2026-08-22）“0.2.1, which exists so that pip install docproof resolves”；RELEASING.md:71-75 亦写 0.2.1–0.2.3 发布时 README 仍称未上 PyPI、0.2.4 才修
findings.replacement: docproof actually going up on PyPI with 0.2.1 on 22 August 2026

findings.excerpt: Both lines are load-bearing ... Measured on `pallets/click` ... permanently green gate that had judged nothing
findings.evidence: README.md:126-132 与 README.md:284-289 近逐字重复（同一 pallets/click 测量、同一 “permanently green gate that had judged nothing” 表述）；126-132 已用 [Requirements](#requirements) 指向专节
findings.replacement: **Both lines are load-bearing.** `actions/checkout` gives you depth 1 unless you ask otherwise, and a shallow clone cannot tell a deleted file from one that never existed. [Requirements](#requirements) has the measurement, the failure mode, and the rest.

findings.excerpt: A clean verdict over five per cent of a repository is not a clean repository
findings.evidence: 审计期间本机两次 fetch 失败；2026-10-18 复测（含同域根路径 https://log.wecanuseai.com/）均返回 200，链接有效；按「不可达≠失效」保留，不改

findings.excerpt: Measured, rather than hoped: sixteen well-known projects ... produced one finding
findings.evidence: 该测量依赖 16 个外部仓库当时的快照，仓库内无日期、无复跑脚本；无法用代码或当前环境复核，按「无法复核的断言」标 NEEDS_HUMAN

findings.excerpt: `0.1.0` and `Development Status :: 3 - Alpha` are meant literally
findings.evidence: 当前版本为 0.2.4（src/docproof/__init__.py:3、远端 tag v0.2.4、README pin 一致）；该句为 0.1.0 时期的成熟度声明沿用还是漏更新属语义决策，默认建议 0.1.0 → 0.x，不静默改
